tasks.title: Essay – traffic in city centres
tasks.prompt:
Your class has watched a documentary about ways of reducing traffic in city centres. You have made the notes below.

Ways of reducing traffic:
• congestion charges
• better public transport
• car-free zones

Some opinions expressed in the documentary:
“Charging drivers just hits people on low incomes.”
“Nobody will leave their car at home if the buses are always late.”
“Streets without cars feel completely different.”

Write an essay discussing two of the ways in your notes. You should explain which way is more effective, giving reasons to support your opinion.

You may, if you wish, make use of the opinions expressed in the documentary, but you should use your own words as far as possible.
points: Wyraźny wybór, który jest skuteczniejszy, z uzasadnieniem
Opinie z polecenia sparafrazowane, nie przepisane

tasks.title: Essay – preparing young people for work
tasks.prompt:
Your class has attended a panel discussion about how schools can prepare young people for working life. You have made the notes below.

Ways schools can prepare young people for work:
• work experience placements
• teaching practical skills
• careers advice

Some opinions expressed in the discussion:
“Two weeks in an office teaches you more than a year in a classroom.”
“Most school leavers can't manage their own money.”
“Advisers often know very little about today's job market.”

Write an essay discussing two of the ways in your notes. You should explain which way is more important for schools to focus on, giving reasons to support your opinion.

You may, if you wish, make use of the opinions expressed in the discussion, but you should use your own words as far as possible.
points: Wyraźny wybór, który jest ważniejszy, z uzasadnieniem
Opinie z polecenia sparafrazowane, nie przepisane

tasks.title: Letter – library opening hours
tasks.prompt:
Your local council has announced plans to reduce the opening hours of the public library in order to save money. Write a letter to the council. In your letter you should explain how you and other residents use the library, describe the effect the reduced hours would have, and suggest other ways the council could save money.

Write your letter.
points: Jak Ty i inni mieszkańcy korzystacie z biblioteki
genreChecklist: Formalne powitanie i zakończenie (Yours faithfully / sincerely)

tasks.title: Email – advice for a friend
tasks.prompt:
You have received this email from an English friend, Sam:

“I've just been offered a six-month internship in your city! I'm really excited but a bit nervous too. Could you give me some advice about where to live, how to meet people and anything I should avoid? Thanks!”

Write your email to Sam.

tasks.title: Proposal – staff wellbeing
tasks.prompt:
The company you work for wants to improve the wellbeing of its staff and has invited employees to send in proposals. Write a proposal describing the main problems affecting staff at the moment, suggesting two or three changes the company could make, and explaining how these changes would benefit both the staff and the company.

Write your proposal.

tasks.title: Report – international festival
tasks.prompt:
You helped to organise an international festival at your college last month. The principal has asked you to write a report. In your report you should evaluate how successful the festival was, describe any problems that occurred, and recommend improvements for next year's festival.

Write your report.
points: Ocena, na ile festiwal był udany
genreChecklist: Tytuł, nagłówki i wstęp z celem raportu
Bezosobowy styl (passive, It is recommended that)

tasks.title: Review – a learning app
tasks.prompt:
You see this announcement on an education website:

“Has an app or online service changed the way you learn something? Write a review telling us what it is, evaluating its strengths and weaknesses, and explaining what kind of people would benefit most from using it.”

Write your review.

tasks.title: Review – an unusual café
tasks.prompt:
A lifestyle magazine is looking for reviews of restaurants or cafés that offer something unusual. Write a review describing the place and what makes it different, evaluating whether it is good value for money, and saying who you would recommend it to.

Write your review.
points: Opis miejsca i tego, co je wyróżnia
